'''House Martan''' is one of the known minor [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Andor]].

Lord [[Brannin Martan]] is the [[High Seat]] of the House. He lends his support to [[Elayne Trakand]] during the [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|Fourth Succession War]], and brings his armsmen to [[Caemlyn]]. He is married to Lady [[Elvaine Martan]].
